item.title: Cirigliano. History, stories, people
item.description: This book is a tribute to Cirigliano, its history, and its community. Born from the patient and passionate research of Giuseppe Urgo, later continued and completed by his son Dino and his grandson Marcello, it reconstructs the historical memory of a village—its places, families, traditions, documents, and images that tell the story of its evolution over time. At a time when many small towns are experiencing steady depopulation and collective memory is at risk of fading, these pages seek to preserve and pass on a heritage of history, identity, and belonging.

item.title: Cirigliano. History, stories, people (english edition)
item.description: TThis book is a tribute to Cirigliano, its history, and its community. The patient and passionate research begun by Giuseppe Urgo, continued and completed by his son Dino and his grandson Marcello, has made it possible to reconstruct the historical memory of a village: its places, families, traditions, documents, and photographs that tell the story of its evolution over time. At a time when many small communities are experiencing steady depopulation and collective memory risks fading away, these pages seek to preserve and pass on a heritage of history, identity, and belonging.
